data.data:
The notifications are spreading. Text and audio data are being sent to every corner of the world. If you have slowed down your travels, listen to the call that beckons us to return to Talos-II.


>>Click to Go to the [Protocol Invitation: The Return] Web Event<<


▼// Event Time

Throughout the [Homecoming] version


▼// Participation Requirements

After the Event Center is unlocked


▼// Event Details

· During the event, you can share your exclusive Invite Code to invite [Returning Members] to the event, and earn [Oroberyl] rewards.

· During the event, [Returning Members] can enter and link another player's Invite Code on the event webpage. Once linked, the code cannot be changed. Complete the linking for an exclusive reward of [Oroberyls].


▼// [Returning Member] Eligibility Criteria

Endministrators who are eligible for the [Protocol Reconnection] event will be considered [Returning Members].


※ For more event details, check the [Protocol Invitation: The Return] event webpage.
